title: Anyone else have a reoccurring house that’s familiar but never seen irl? Maybe Victorian looking?Lots of wood and an huge finished but empty endless attic? I always know the house and neighborhood in my dream. Also I keep finding a little random shop in this never ending attic.
content: It starts out a white sided house with lots of dark wood inside. In my dream I am familiar with it and live there I believe. The staircase railing has white spindles and the rest is a dark cherry colored wood. Very pretty swirly and polished. The attic overlooks a neighborhood I see often in my dreams but never have been, very Americana looking and upper middle class, of which I ain’t. Lawns and sidewalks. Sometimes if I get lost in this giant empty huge dark wood attic I find a little shop. Has some Christmas lights; dim yellowy lighting, small isles, with snacks, a few refrigerated cases for drinks; yet also sells random items. It’s like a little bodega. One day my dad was working the register like it was totally normal. Said he’s here all the time, I often buy a soda and or some antique toy from my youth there. I also think they sell magical items idk, it has a magical air about it. It’s also always very stocked bordering on cluttery. Seems to just appear out of nowhere in this vast attic. I always know the house and am always watching the streets below from the little attic window but the little shop is a surprise I stumbled upon twice but in my dreams I know it’s there I just can never directly find it; I just appears. It’s like I accidentally find it by taking a wrong turn in this crazy attic and when I do and can never willingly find it, always just stumble upon it. Like every time I go there I am surprised but I know the house… idk. Like finding new secret passageways in places you know. Sorry if this is weird. Anyone else have similar things? Or can explain what they mean?
